message.content:
Here are a few highly regarded documentaries that explore global warming and climate change:

| Title | Year | Synopsis | Where to Watch |
|-------|------|----------|----------------|
| **“An Inconvenient Truth”** | 2006 | Former Vice‑President Al Gore presents a compelling overview of climate science, evidence, and policy options. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **“An Inconvenient Sequel: Truth to Power”** | 2017 | A follow‑up that examines progress (or lack thereof) since the first film, featuring new data and interviews with scientists and activists. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes, Google Play |
| **“Before the Flood”** | 2016 | Leonardo DiCaprio travels the world to witness the impacts of climate change and discusses solutions. | Netflix, Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **“Climate Change: The Facts”** | 2019 | A BBC production that breaks down the science, economics, and politics behind global warming. | BBC iPlayer, Amazon Prime Video |
| **“The 11th Hour”** | 2007 | A global environmental documentary featuring voices from science, business, and faith communities. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |
| **“Our Planet”** (Season 1) | 2019 | While primarily a nature series, it highlights how climate change threatens ecosystems worldwide. | Netflix |
| **“The Age of Consequences”** | 2020 | Explores how climate change is reshaping geopolitics and security. | Amazon Prime Video, iTunes |

If you’re looking for something more recent or region‑specific, let me know and I can dig up additional titles!
